mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the month-over-month change in FEDFUNDS over the next 20 days is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 325.0 indicates persistent inflation that triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 325.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor market is strong (PAYEMS growth above 158,000) and inflation is elevated (CPIAUCSL > 325.0), the combined signal triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS>158000 and CPIAUCSL>325.0) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and GDPC1 year-over-year growth > 2.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to overvaluation and impending monetary tightening, over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when the late-cycle regime is active, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in the real economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the month-over-month change in FEDFUNDS over the next 5 days is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year real GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.5%, it signals strong economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals an immediate economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
